decisions.reason: The client explicitly requires all-cap lettering to maintain consistency on both the base and the machine.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Ok, for the base logo, let's keep it simple. Let's take the leaf off of the logo. For the letters, let's use the same font as the "KARLA'S MATCHA MIXER" on top. Let's make it all caps. This way it is consistent on both the base and the machine.

decisions.reason: The source changes the base logo's leaf and typography but does not change any enclosure, platform, or button colors.
The instruction to keep the base logo simple does not alter the machine's DJ-turntable visual theme.
The source concerns the base logo lettering, not the cursive K markings on the dispense buttons.
Logo typography has no necessary effect on spout location, geometry, fabrication, or pour direction.
Applying a revised logo treatment to the base does not change the platform's height, purpose, type, or footprint.
The base logo decision does not affect bowl capacity, dimensions, form, or selection priorities.
The source does not change the base height, supported cup size, or required clearance below the spouts.
The base logo treatment does not change the master power button or its placement.
The source contains no change to the solenoid valve, dispense-button actuation, or closed-state behavior.
The logo's simplified visual treatment does not affect splash-control behavior or methods.
The source changes only base-logo graphics and typography, not enclosure size, profile, or accommodation of deep wells.
